extraction_text: The Company shall not be hindered in or prevented from using any type or quality of machinery, tools, and appliances, and may secure materials or equipment from any market or source it deems fit without interference from the Union.

attributes.context: The clause appears as Clause 12 in a series of work rules and is followed by Clause 13, which commits both parties to develop trainee positions and policies to keep the companies competitive.

extraction_text: 12. The Company will provide a helper on drills without automatic steel changers when drilling pre-split slopes of 3/4 to 1 or flatter when requested by the operator.
